description: Synthetic community households coordinate limited repair contributions during a temporary shared water-service capacity shock, with four alternative decision policies.

network.tie_change: not_implemented; topology is fixed during each run

service.recovery_requires_contributions: only within the declared shock window; after the exogenous window ends, baseline capacity returns

run.random_seed_policy: same seed list across all treatment arms; fixed per-tick action and observation random channels
run.inequality_metric_definition: Gini coefficient of each agent's cumulative unmet need over the run

one_factor_sweep.design: one factor at a time; all other parameters set to baseline
one_factor_sweep.limitations: does not estimate interactions; network topology is fixed; synthetic sensitivity only

note: Synthetic proposal fixture aligned to the dependency-free Rust reference model defaults. The evidence_based_trust arm models noisy observations, observation cost, trust updating, and probabilistic signal tampering only; it does not model verifiable commitments or formal dispute resolution. The one-factor sweep is synthetic sensitivity analysis, not empirical validation.
